svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
a quarter turn of a grid 8 wide, then a key of 9 letters: each known letter's key value, grouped by key slot (carved place mod 9)
outlined values disagree with their slot: 14 in all; one carving error excuses only 1
smallest key length with at most one miss
move then key, settings that fit, 27,852 moves x 8 tables; accent where the copper is outside the scrambled coppers' range
OUT: NO READING; ONE CARVING ERROR BUYS NOTHING
